An adapter is not a partnership, endorsement or guarantee of complete coverage. Availability depends on the source, your configuration, rate limits and the job board’s current API. This page does not run a scan or make external requests.

Evidence sources are different.

Recovery evidence comes from the achievements and source excerpts you provide. Job-board data does not verify your career claims. The recovery app lets you paste real job descriptions for manual requirement comparison; job discovery belongs to the separate workspace and engine.
